rows.evidence: The pytest run after the fix (T0B5) showed 6 passed and 2 failed. The failures were test_holidays_are_informational and test_week_one_starts_on_first_monday. test_midweek, which asserts parse_iso_week("2026-W05-3") == date(2026,1,28), is not among the failures, so it passed. Only a failure summary was displayed, but the tail output and the failure list make this clear.
